name: Curriculum and Learning Management Division
agency: Department of Education – Regional Office XII
tagline: Transforming Learning Through Quality Curriculum and Excellent Educational Leadership
vision: A responsive and future-ready regional learning system where every learner in SOCCSKSARGEN receives relevant, inclusive, culture-responsive, and high-quality basic education.
mission: CLMD provides curriculum leadership, learning resource stewardship, program management, assessment support, research, and technical assistance that empower Schools Division Offices and schools to improve learning outcomes.
